references.text: This prophecy states that a ruler shall come from Bethlehem Ephrathah, which aligns with the claim in John 7:42 that the Messiah must come from this city.
Here God promises to raise up David's descendant and build a house for him, establishing the requirement that the Messiah must be of David's lineage, a central point in John 7:42.
God swears an oath to David that one of his descendants shall sit on his throne, underscoring the requirement of Davidic descent mentioned in John 7:42.
The prophecy describes that a shoot will come out from David's line, confirming the requirement that the Messiah must be of David's family.
